title: TODSphere: open-data screening of transit-oriented development with the Node–Place–People–Ecology (NPPE) framework
description:
TODSphere is browser-based research software for open-data screening of transit-oriented development (TOD). It computes seven indicators covering transit accessibility, built density, land-use diversity, walkability, amenity accessibility, green space and near-road air-quality screening, aggregates them into Node, Place, People and Ecology (NPPE) dimensions, and provides composite scores, ranking and robustness diagnostics.

TODSphere is a planning-screening and research-support tool; its outputs are not a substitute for field validation, statutory planning review, exposure modelling or professional judgement.
